notes.title: Demo Update: Save System, Level Select & Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Demo Version Updated![/b]

This update brings a set of improvements to make the experience smoother and more complete:

[list]
[*] Added a save system
[*] You can now start a new game or continue from where you left off
[*] Level selection is now available from the main menu
[*] Checkpoints have been added to tougher sections
[*] Screen fade-in/out effect added when starting the game
[*] Several minor bugs fixed
[/list]

[b]Thanks to everyone who played and shared feedback![/b]
This update makes the demo feel much closer to the final version. Try it out and let me know what you think!

Play demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542470/Leo_The_Square_Demo/
